creator: andrew_kevorkian
caption:
Breakfasts are prepped for the week ✅

580 cal | 29g protein per box - 2 hard-boiled eggs, 2 hashbrowns, 2 turkey sausage links, and 6 mini protein pancakes. Diner breakfast energy, macro plan results.

Which box are you grabbing first? 👇

Tracked with MacroFactor - link in bio to try it

#mealprep #highprotein #macros #mealprepideas #practicalmacros

hook.whyItWorks: The number is the promise: a breakfast with real protein without a shake. The full prep spread in frame one makes it look abundant rather than restrictive.

format.visualLayout: Overhead and angled shots of glass containers being filled on a white counter, bold italic text labels, licensed music
format.pacing: medium, about 1 cut every 2 to 3s, each component gets its own label
format.reasoning: No talking: the satisfying build from empty boxes to full ones is the whole video, and each label doubles as the recipe so it works muted. The app overlay gives exact macros for anyone saving it.

angle.angle: Diner-style breakfast boxes (hash brown, mini protein pancakes, eggs, sausage) prepped for the week with macros
angle.commonBelief: A high-protein breakfast means a shake or plain egg whites
angle.contrarianTake: A fun plate of familiar foods can still hit a solid protein number
